question: Which combined strategy best controls both plastic pollution and nutrient pollution in water?
urdu_translation: کون سی combined strategy water میں plastic pollution اور nutrient pollution دونوں کو best control کرتی ہے؟
A: Burn plastics near rivers and increase fertilizer use / rivers کے near plastics burn کریں اور fertilizer use بڑھائیں
B: Reuse or recycle plastics and minimize fertilizer use / plastics reuse یا recycle کریں اور fertilizer use minimize کریں
C: Add untreated sewage and detergents to water / untreated sewage اور detergents water میں add کریں
D: Use more pesticides and discard oils into drains / زیادہ pesticides use کریں اور oils drains میں discard کریں
correct_answer: B | Reuse or recycle plastics and minimize fertilizer use / plastics reuse یا recycle کریں اور fertilizer use minimize کریں

question: Pakistan is mainly included in which climatic region according to the chapter?
urdu_translation: باب کے مطابق Pakistan mainly کس climatic region میں شامل ہے؟
A: Polar region / polar region
B: Equatorial rainforest region / equatorial rainforest region
C: Tundra region / tundra region
D: Semi-arid region / semi-arid region
correct_answer: D | Semi-arid region / semi-arid region

question: What annual rainfall range is stated for northern Pakistan including Punjab?
urdu_translation: northern Pakistan including Punjab کے لیے کون سا annual rainfall range stated ہے؟
A: Below 50 mm per year / 50 mm per year سے below
B: 1000–1500 mm per year / 1000–1500 mm per year
C: 250–600 mm per year / 250–600 mm per year
D: 2000–3000 mm per year / 2000–3000 mm per year
correct_answer: C | 250–600 mm per year / 250–600 mm per year

question: Which set includes causes of water scarcity in Pakistan?
urdu_translation: کون سا set Pakistan میں water scarcity کی causes شامل کرتا ہے؟
A: Excess rainfall, low population and efficient irrigation / excess rainfall، low population اور efficient irrigation
B: Low rainfall, population growth, flood irrigation, climate change, depleting aquifers and poor management / low rainfall، population growth، flood irrigation، climate change، depleting aquifers اور poor management
C: Only dissolved oxygen and filtration / صرف dissolved oxygen اور filtration
D: Only fertilizer production and distillation / صرف fertilizer production اور distillation
correct_answer: B | Low rainfall, population growth, flood irrigation, climate change, depleting aquifers and poor management / low rainfall، population growth، flood irrigation، climate change، depleting aquifers اور poor management

question: Which measure can help Pakistan address water scarcity?
urdu_translation: کون سا measure Pakistan کو water scarcity address کرنے میں مدد دے سکتا ہے؟
A: Increase flood irrigation losses / flood irrigation losses بڑھائیں
B: Allow aquifers to deplete without control / aquifers کو control کے بغیر deplete ہونے دیں
C: Collect rainwater and improve irrigation and water-resource management / rainwater collect کریں اور irrigation و water-resource management improve کریں
D: Avoid construction of storage facilities / storage facilities کی construction avoid کریں
correct_answer: C | Collect rainwater and improve irrigation and water-resource management / rainwater collect کریں اور irrigation و water-resource management improve کریں

question: Which policy package most directly addresses both low rainfall and inefficient agricultural water use?
urdu_translation: کون سا policy package low rainfall اور inefficient agricultural water use دونوں کو most directly address کرتا ہے؟
A: Increase flood irrigation and remove reservoirs / flood irrigation بڑھائیں اور reservoirs remove کریں
B: Depend only on depleting aquifers / صرف depleting aquifers پر depend کریں
C: Build reservoirs for monsoon rainwater and adopt better crop-irrigation techniques / monsoon rainwater کے لیے reservoirs build کریں اور better crop-irrigation techniques adopt کریں
D: Use more water-intensive crops without management / management کے بغیر زیادہ water-intensive crops use کریں
correct_answer: C | Build reservoirs for monsoon rainwater and adopt better crop-irrigation techniques / monsoon rainwater کے لیے reservoirs build کریں اور better crop-irrigation techniques adopt کریں

question: What are micro-nutrients?
urdu_translation: micro-nutrients کیا ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Nutrients required in the largest possible amounts / nutrients جو largest possible amounts میں درکار ہوتے ہیں
B: Only gases used in respiration / صرف gases جو respiration میں use ہوتی ہیں
C: Nutrients required by plants in very small amounts / nutrients جو plants کو very small amounts میں درکار ہوتے ہیں
D: Substances that are always toxic at any amount / substances جو ہر amount میں ہمیشہ toxic ہوں
correct_answer: C | Nutrients required by plants in very small amounts / nutrients جو plants کو very small amounts میں درکار ہوتے ہیں

question: What are macro-nutrients?
urdu_translation: macro-nutrients کیا ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Nutrients required only in trace amounts / nutrients جو صرف trace amounts میں درکار ہوتے ہیں
B: Only nutrients supplied by distilled water / صرف nutrients جو distilled water supply کرتی ہے
C: Nutrients required by plants in large amounts / nutrients جو plants کو large amounts میں درکار ہوتے ہیں
D: Microbes that damage roots / microbes جو roots damage کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: C | Nutrients required by plants in large amounts / nutrients جو plants کو large amounts میں درکار ہوتے ہیں

question: Which element is a micro-nutrient?
urdu_translation: کون سا element micro-nutrient ہے؟
A: Nitrogen / nitrogen
B: Potassium / potassium
C: Carbon / carbon
D: Boron / boron
correct_answer: D | Boron / boron

question: Why can excessive addition of micro-nutrients be harmful?
urdu_translation: micro-nutrients کا excessive addition harmful کیوں ہو سکتا ہے؟
A: They always remove all soil water / وہ ہمیشہ تمام soil water remove کرتے ہیں
B: They convert soil into plastic / وہ soil کو plastic میں convert کرتے ہیں
C: They may become poisonous in larger quantities / larger quantities میں وہ poisonous ہو سکتے ہیں
D: They prevent every plant from absorbing nitrogen / وہ ہر plant کو nitrogen absorb کرنے سے روکتے ہیں
correct_answer: C | They may become poisonous in larger quantities / larger quantities میں وہ poisonous ہو سکتے ہیں

question: Which pair correctly classifies one micro-nutrient and one macro-nutrient?
urdu_translation: کون سا pair one micro-nutrient اور one macro-nutrient کو correctly classify کرتا ہے؟
A: Zinc as a micro-nutrient and nitrogen as a macro-nutrient / zinc micro-nutrient اور nitrogen macro-nutrient
B: Nitrogen as a micro-nutrient and boron as a macro-nutrient / nitrogen micro-nutrient اور boron macro-nutrient
C: Potassium as a micro-nutrient and copper as a macro-nutrient / potassium micro-nutrient اور copper macro-nutrient
D: Calcium as a micro-nutrient and chlorine as a macro-nutrient / calcium micro-nutrient اور chlorine macro-nutrient
correct_answer: A | Zinc as a micro-nutrient and nitrogen as a macro-nutrient / zinc micro-nutrient اور nitrogen macro-nutrient

question: What is the main purpose of adding fertilizers to soil?
urdu_translation: soil میں fertilizers add کرنے کا main purpose کیا ہے؟
A: To remove all nutrients from soil / soil سے تمام nutrients remove کرنا
B: To supply deficient essential elements such as nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium / deficient essential elements جیسے nitrogen، phosphorus اور potassium supply کرنا
C: To make every soil strongly acidic / ہر soil کو strongly acidic بنانا
D: To replace water with plastics / water کو plastics سے replace کرنا
correct_answer: B | To supply deficient essential elements such as nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium / deficient essential elements جیسے nitrogen، phosphorus اور potassium supply کرنا

question: Which fertilizer contains about 46% nitrogen and is the most concentrated solid nitrogen fertilizer?
urdu_translation: کون سا fertilizer تقریباً 46% nitrogen رکھتا ہے اور most concentrated solid nitrogen fertilizer ہے؟
A: Potassium chloride / potassium chloride
B: Urea / urea
C: Super phosphate / super phosphate
D: Calcium sulphate / calcium sulphate
correct_answer: B | Urea / urea

question: Which fertilizer is unsuitable for paddy rice according to the chapter?
urdu_translation: باب کے مطابق کون سا fertilizer paddy rice کے لیے unsuitable ہے؟
A: Urea / urea
B: Potassium sulphate / potassium sulphate
C: Ammonium nitrate / ammonium nitrate
D: Super phosphate / super phosphate
correct_answer: C | Ammonium nitrate / ammonium nitrate

question: Which is an essential quality of a good fertilizer?
urdu_translation: good fertilizer کی essential quality کون سی ہے؟
A: It should be insoluble and permanently unavailable / اسے insoluble اور permanently unavailable ہونا چاہیے
B: It should always alter soil pH strongly / اسے ہمیشہ soil pH strongly alter کرنا چاہیے
C: It should absorb moisture and form hard stones / اسے moisture absorb کر کے hard stones بنانے چاہئیں
D: Its nutrients should be water-soluble, available to plants, stable, inexpensive and non-injurious / اس کے nutrients water-soluble، plants کے لیے available، stable، inexpensive اور non-injurious ہونے چاہئیں
correct_answer: D | Its nutrients should be water-soluble, available to plants, stable, inexpensive and non-injurious / اس کے nutrients water-soluble، plants کے لیے available، stable، inexpensive اور non-injurious ہونے چاہئیں

question: What is a major function of phosphatic fertilizers?
urdu_translation: phosphatic fertilizers کا major function کیا ہے؟
A: They only produce green leaf colour / وہ صرف green leaf colour produce کرتے ہیں
B: They remove roots from plants / وہ plants سے roots remove کرتے ہیں
C: They decrease seed formation / وہ seed formation decrease کرتے ہیں
D: They stimulate early growth, seed and fruit formation, and disease resistance / وہ early growth، seed اور fruit formation اور disease resistance stimulate کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: D | They stimulate early growth, seed and fruit formation, and disease resistance / وہ early growth، seed اور fruit formation اور disease resistance stimulate کرتے ہیں

question: A crop needs stronger roots, greater disease resistance and improved ripening of seeds and fruits. Which fertilizer class is most suitable?
urdu_translation: ایک crop کو stronger roots، greater disease resistance اور seeds و fruits کی improved ripening درکار ہے۔ کون سی fertilizer class most suitable ہے؟
A: Nitrogenous fertilizers / nitrogenous fertilizers
B: Phosphatic fertilizers only / صرف phosphatic fertilizers
C: Magnesium fertilizers / magnesium fertilizers
D: Potassium fertilizers / potassium fertilizers
correct_answer: D | Potassium fertilizers / potassium fertilizers
